capabilities.ui: guardian web GUI (gui/, shared Web Host) and reviewer renderer

limitations: The web GUI is the guardian's view through the Agent connection only: no staff or reviewer console; staff, the cafeteria and the other guardian act only through events.
One guardian account in one district per App instance; guardian links and restrictions are set only by the seed.
No real payments: a payment method is a record with a status and an expiry month.
Forms are structured JSON; no PDF or image attachments.
Mail notices are stored as wire messages and dispatched only by the Infra-run sender (src/publisher.cjs); no outbox or cross-App transaction.
